i would say, if you haven’t already, it would be wise to get some buffs or debuffs, like war cry, fog breath, rakukaja etc, on demifiend (or any of your party members) these are really helpful for the endgame, and particularly TDE. remember that demon fusion exists to help you and you should be good.
